svg.title: Immortal annulus approaching a plane with multiplicity two
svg.desc: Schematic rotational surface with a positive neck radius and two planar ends at finite time. The right panel represents its local multiplicity-two plane limit as time tends to infinity. No finite-time singularity or computed critical solution is depicted.
svg.text: An immortal annulus in Euclidean space
Schematic geometry · no critical PDE solution is plotted
Truncated view · two planar ends and a neck
The neck collapses only at infinite time.
The two ends keep their fixed asymptotic planes; convergence is local.
